item.title: WICN Artist of the Month, November 2025: Mildred Bailey - 90.5 WICN Public Radio
item.description: Mildred Bailey, often called the “Queen of Swing,” was a Native American jazz singer during the 1930s. Known for her light soprano voice, clear articulation, and jazz phrasing, Bailey was one of the first nonblack performers to become a skilled jazz singer.
